{{Navbar-Global_Coal_Plant_Tracker}}
'''Shanxi Hepo power station''' (山西国际能源河坡发电厂) is an operating power station of at least 700-megawatts (MW) in Yingying Town Xiayan Villege Baiquan Industrial Park, Jiaoqu, Yangquan, Shanxi, China with multiple units, some of which are not currently operating.

==Ownership Tree==

This ownership tree is part of the [https://globalenergymonitor.org/projects/global-energy-ownership-tracker/ Global Energy Ownership Tracker], a project of Global Energy Monitor.

{{#widget:ObservableOwnershipTree|}}

==Background==

The four existing coal-fired units of Shanxi Hepo power station, totaling 300 MW, were brought online between 1991 and 2000. The plant is owned by [[Shanxi International Electricity Group]].<ref>[http://bit.ly/1CObppU "关于山西河坡发电有限责任公司“上大压小”热电联产异地新建工程(变更)补充环境影响报告书的批复"], 中华人民共和国环境保护部, 2014-04-14</ref> 

The 4 units were retired in 2016 after the expansion units went operation.<ref>[http://www.sxgjny.com/hpfd/SubComInfo.aspx?comId=58&catalogId=115&tp=Pro&SubCatalogID=22&menuid=1"山西河坡发电有限责任公司企业简介,"] International Energy Group, accessed Jan 2018</ref>

==Description of Expansion==

Shanxi International Electricity Group is currently building two additional coal-fired units at this plant, with a total planned capacity of 700 MW. The new units are scheduled to be completed in 2015.<ref>[http://bit.ly/1AvjLPf "山西河坡电厂2×350兆瓦超临界热电联产项目开工"], 阳泉市政府, 2012-09-24</ref><ref>[http://www.huanqiu803.com/sell/show-htm-itemid-40528.html "山西河坡发电公司北侧大门及煤场管理站建筑安装工程招标,"] 015-06-10</ref>

The new units were completed in 2016.<ref>[http://mt.sohu.com/it/d20170111/123985066_131990.shtml "[独家]2016年12月电力项目情况:涉及核准、开工、并网等,"] Sohu, Jan 10, 2017</ref>
